summary: security fix for the Markdown GFM, HTML support and HTML embed packages
Cross-site scripting (XSS) in the clipboard package

A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the CKEditor 5 clipboard package. It can be triggered by specific user actions if the editor is configured with either the HTML embed plugin or a custom plugin introducing a view RawElement, allowing unauthorized JavaScript code execution when malicious content is inserted.
